reason: An authenticated reverse-proxy plugin for remotely accessing the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, including privileged APIs, device sessions, audit logging, and optional temporary Cloudflare tunneling; human review is warranted because it enables remote access to sensitive capabilities.

summaries.zh: 通过带有令牌和设备会话控制的反向代理，将 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 及其部分特权 API 暴露给局域网或远程设备使用。
summaries.en: Provides authenticated reverse-proxy access to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI and selected privileged APIs from local or remote devices.

capabilities: Exposes the DeepSeek Harness Web UI through an authenticated reverse proxy
Forwards HTTP, SSE, and WebSocket traffic to the Harness Web server
Rewrites Host and Origin headers before forwarding requests
Provides access to privileged settings, credentials, directory, and model APIs
Manages access tokens, device sessions, invitations, approvals, and revocations
Can optionally start a temporary Cloudflare quick tunnel
Records authentication and proxy lifecycle events in an audit log
